code.execution_tree_note: execute requires the committed, clean preregistration; source files listed here are compared with the execution commit

extraction_sql.dividends: SELECT ex_date,amount FROM daily_dividends WHERE ticker='PGR' AND ex_date < ? ORDER BY ex_date
extraction_sql.first_reported: SELECT month_end,field,value_real,filing_date FROM pgr_edgar_monthly_first_reported WHERE month_end < ? AND filing_date < ? AND field IN ('book_value_per_share','combined_ratio','pif_total','net_premiums_written','roe_net_income_ttm','investment_book_yield') ORDER BY month_end,field
extraction_sql.prices: SELECT date,close FROM daily_prices WHERE ticker='PGR' AND date < ? ORDER BY date
extraction_sql.reports: SELECT month_end,filing_date,book_value_per_share,combined_ratio,pif_total,net_premiums_written,roe_net_income_ttm,gainshare_estimate,investment_book_yield FROM pgr_edgar_monthly WHERE month_end < ? AND filing_date < ? ORDER BY month_end
extraction_sql.splits: SELECT split_date,split_ratio FROM split_history WHERE ticker='PGR' AND split_date < ? ORDER BY split_date

input_db.access: git show export outside the repository, verified, opened read-only immutable

calibration.matched: rows where candidate and control are both past warmup
calibration.method: prequential empirical residual quantiles/frequency from the same stream's matured residuals only
calibration.probability: share of matured residuals with forecast + residual above the event threshold

direction.base: constant majority event of labels matured by origin
direction.cash_dividend_12m: next-12M cash strictly above the fixed past-12M control
direction.skill_test: one-sided block test of per-date hit minus base hit, reported raw; a safeguard, not a success route

procedure.disposition: Pass only if relative MAE reduction >= .10 vs the matched v200 control, Holm-adjusted primary p < .05 (38-test campaign family, pending slots p=1), delta honest R2 >= .01, candidate hit rate >= control hit rate, candidate Brier <= control Brier, |coverage80-.80| <= control's + .05, scored dates / horizon >= 5 independent blocks and supported block inference. NaN fails.
procedure.feature_rows: all registered features finite; no imputation of a missing report month

folds.availability: training labels need target end, filing or label availability and origin before the (inner) test origin; inner validation labels must have arrived by the outer origin
folds.dates: contiguous business month-ends spanning the v200 control origins of each endpoint; unique monthly dates split before any row expansion
folds.h12: outer TimeSeriesSplit 120 train / 6 test / gap 24; inner 3 folds test 6 gap 24, minimum 60 usable months
folds.h6: outer TimeSeriesSplit 60 train / 6 test / gap 12; inner 3 folds test 6 gap 12, minimum 24 usable months
folds.outer_minimum: the outer training fold also needs at least 60 (h12) or 24 (h6) usable mature labels, or it is unscorable
folds.unsupported: unscorable; gaps and support are never reduced

procedure.holdout: no quarantine label, feature or metric is read
procedure.honest_r2_naive: v200 prevailing mean of same-endpoint labels matured by origin
procedure.matched_rows: Outer-test rows with a finite candidate forecast, a finite non-warmup v200 control forecast and naive mean, and a finite label
procedure.nomination: At most one winner across both lanes: lowest adjusted p, then largest relative MAE reduction; none if nothing passes
procedure.post_result_search: none; no feature, lag, threshold, window or grid change after results
procedure.share_basis: Dollar features, targets and offsets are restated to the share basis of each fold's first test origin before fitting; forecasts are restated back to each test origin's basis

runtime.installation_note: Python 3.12.14 and the complete v200 package set installed at exact versions in an isolated venv; verify_runtime passed
